blocks.text: Clayface premiered at the Hollywood Legion Theater in Los Angeles, where its stars reunited for the big event.
Tom Rhys Harries plays the title role in the DC Comics film, which also stars Naomi Ackie and Max Minghella.
The film also includes Eddie Marsan, David Dencik, Nancy Carroll, Joshua James, Francesca Corney, Ruby Sear, and Wil Coban.

blocks.text: Per DC, the film “unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.”

Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini penned the script for the pic, produced by Reeves, Lynn Harris, and DC Studios’ James Gunn and Safran. Executive producers are Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Rafi Crohn, and Paul Richie.

When you sit and watch this, and you feel the anima of an audience responding to the film, there’s some comfort in that, I suppose.”
